scenario: [RFCS.7.3] a replay stops with DS_ERR_FS_UNKNOWN_FACT_ID (-730) at a FactRetract whose fact_id no earlier FactAssert, FactEmit or ExternalAssert carries. The harness ([RCTS.1.2.18]) records a Parcel assert, a pump, the host's retract of that fact and a pump, then writes 127 over the FactRetract's one-byte fact_id (`retract_unknown_fact_id`): no atom in the recording carries 127. The unaltered recording must replay, so the refusal is the edit's. Paths: libds's `ds_rfcs_replay` FactRetract arm, whose id map holds only the ids of facts live when their atoms were read (`rfcs/codec.c`); the Mercury runtime's `ds.replay`, whose retract arm ends the replay with `unknown_fact_id` when the id is not in its known set. This pins an id never carried; a second retract of a carried id, which the clause also refuses, is not pinned here.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Parcel scope logical:
    id: String key
    w: Int mutable

rule weigh:
    Parcel
->
    log info "w"
